name: CHENOPODIUM ANTHELMINTICUM
key_symptoms: Intense pain between angle of right shoulder-blade near spine, and through the chest.
Urine.--Copious, yellow, foaming urine, with acrid sensation in urethra. Yellowish sediment (Chel).
guiding_symptoms: Intense pain between angle of right shoulder-blade near spine, and through the chest.
Urine.--Copious, yellow, foaming urine, with acrid sensation in urethra. Yellowish sediment (Chel).
head_symptoms: Torpor of auditory nerve. Hearing better for high-pitched sounds. Comparative deafness to sound of voice, but great sensitiveness to sound, as of passing vehicles and also a shrinking from low tones. Buzzing in ears. Enlargement of tonsils. Aural vertigo.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Intense pain between angle of right shoulder-blade near spine, and through the chest.
Urine.--Copious, yellow, foaming urine, with acrid sensation in urethra. Yellowish sediment (Chel).
